name: playrunner
description: Build and run Playrunner Cloud testing workflows from Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Create Playrunner Cloud projects, environments, Authentication Profiles and Playwright workflows from Codex. Connect GitHub, run saved workflows and investigate execution results.

Connect a Playrunner Cloud account to get started. Account setup and usage limits apply. Codex guides browser authorization when GitHub access or a test sign-in is needed.

Browser sign-ins for Authentication Profiles require a local computer with Node.js 20+ and npm. With command approval, the included skill downloads the pinned Playrunner CLI into npm’s cache and pairs the authentication companion. Other Cloud workflow operations use the hosted MCP server without a local CLI. Passwords and MFA codes are entered directly in the browser.

Running tests may consume workflow-run allowance. Workflow completion is reported separately from test evidence. The plugin does not upload uncommitted application changes automatically.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Playrunner Cloud workflow for my staging checkout tests.
Connect GitHub and configure an Authentication Profile for my tests.
Run my Playrunner workflow and explain any failures.
